hero.title: Ship your SaaS,
hero.subtitle: Maestro is a production-ready Laravel 13 + Inertia 3 starter kit that ships with multi-tenant isolation, RBAC, i18n, themes, and passkeys — so you can focus on what makes your product unique.

logos.kicker: Built with the stack you already trust

features.title: Everything you need to launch a multitenant SaaS.
features.subtitle: Six pillars, wired together and ready to extend.

tenancy.title: Tenancy isolation
tenancy.description: Each tenant gets its own database and session scope, identified by domain — powered by stancl/tenancy.

rbac.title: Roles & permissions
rbac.description: Granular access control with spatie/laravel-permission. Manage roles, permissions, and policies from the UI.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.description: ICU plural support, lazy-loaded namespaces, browser detection — English and Spanish out of the box.

themes.title: Light, dark, system
themes.description: Per-user appearance preferences with SSR-safe cookies and zero flash on load.

security.title: Passkeys & 2FA
security.description: Passwordless sign-in via WebAuthn and TOTP-based two-factor authentication, fully integrated with Fortify.

ids.title: ULIDs everywhere
ids.description: Sortable, time-ordered identifiers for tenants, domains, and records — ready for scale.

stack.title: A modern, type-safe foundation.
stack.subtitle: Maestro leans on battle-tested tools and ergonomic frameworks.

demo.title: See it in motion.
demo.subtitle: A 30-second tour of the dashboard, tenant switcher, and theme system.
demo.fallback: Your browser does not support the video tag.
demo.comingSoon: Demo coming soon — generate it locally with Remotion.

code.title: Provision a tenant in three lines.
code.subtitle: Domain identified. Database cloned. Migrations run. You're live.
code.caption: Built on stancl/tenancy + Inertia 3 + React 19.

cta.title: Ready to compose your SaaS?
cta.subtitle: Fork the boilerplate, brand it, and ship your first tenant this week.

tenantWelcome.title: Welcome to {name}
tenantWelcome.subtitle: You're inside the tenant workspace for
tenantWelcome.explanation: A tenant is an isolated slice of the platform — its own database, its own users, its own configuration. Everything you do here is scoped to this tenant and invisible to the others.
tenantWelcome.isolationSubtitle: Three guarantees that keep every tenant safe by default.

database.title: Isolated database
database.description: Each tenant owns its own database connection. Queries can't leak across tenants — full stop.

session.title: Scoped sessions
session.description: Authentication, cookies, and cache keys are namespaced by tenant. Sessions never cross boundaries.

domains.title: Domain routing
domains.description: Tenants are identified by hostname, so users always land on the right workspace — no manual switching.

tenantWelcome.quickActionsSubtitle: Sign in to manage your tenant, or create an account to get started.
tenantWelcome.infoPanelSubtitle: Identifiers and routing info for this workspace.
